chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in a man urinating in flowing water, and it is disliked that he urinate in still water.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urinating in flowing water versus still water in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning etiquette and cleanliness in relieving oneself. It permits urinating in flowing water while indicating dislike for doing so in still water, reflecting concern for taharah and proper conduct.
